cases.name: parses multi-file diffs into strict file records
cases.patch:
--- one.txt
+++ one.txt
@@ -1 +1 @@
-old one
+new one
--- two.txt
+++ two.txt
@@ -1 +1 @@
-old two
+new two

cases.name: formats per-file patch text from structured patches
does not mutate create/delete hunk offsets while formatting
reads create, delete, and rename paths
normalizes hunk line counts to match git apply tolerance
cases.patch:
--- alpha.py
+++ alpha.py
@@ -1,7 +1,7 @@
 def greet(name):
-    return "Hello, " + name
+    return f"Hello, {name}! 👋"
 
 def add(a, b):
-    return a + b
+    return a + b  # integer or float addition
 
 def subtract(a, b):
     return a - b
